observations.B01: The small word before graphe is faint. A single heavy strike passes through the final phrase; its tall loop and final descending stroke are insufficient to settle developpe/deploie. The tilted trace at the lower edge belongs to the following line and is excluded.
observations.B02: The initial joined letters are tentative. I has upper and lower bars; the A has a tilde, a separate prime and a low oval zero. Upper-edge descenders from the preceding line are excluded.
observations.B03: The first numeral in the type has a sharply bent head and is uncertain between 2 and 4. I, J and 3 are elevated with insertion leaders. The compressed words before I are uncertain, with two deep initial strokes and a later tall t-like stroke; alternatives are retained.
observations.B04: The marked-point abbreviation has an elevated t; the next plural abbreviation has raised ts. The final element-word is very compressed and may be abbreviated.
observations.B05: At the first J there is an elevated vertical stroke and a separate lower dot: the exclamation reading is preserved against a possible prime-plus-zero. The A has a distinct tilde, prime and zero. A clipped top-edge trace is excluded.
observations.B06: The label second digit is narrow and hooked, retained as 4/3 uncertainty. Both J-primes on this line have elevated strokes without separated lower dots. The disjoint-union sign has two upright prongs.
observations.B07: The deleted glyph to the right of the P has a dense triangular overwrite and a surviving low J-prime-like trace; G with that subscript is tentative. The blackboard P has a doubled upright.
observations.B08: A small separate angled stroke occurs at the upper right of G; its interpretation as a raised 1 remains uncertain. The wedge subscript has a vertical crossing and lower bar consistent with plus-or-minus, followed by 1. Marginal and upper clipped fragments are excluded.
observations.B09: The crossed initial symbol retains doubled diagonals like Z and a low 2-like curve. The group symbol itself has a large open round stroke and interior horizontal stroke. Upper-edge preceding text is excluded.
observations.B10: The tall initial stroke in structure is joined to the following low sequence; the later capital O, n and small a are read On a.
observations.B11: Fresh margin crop rotated 30 degrees clockwise and viewed. Epsilon has two curved lobes; the final numeral is an upright 1 with a horizontal foot. Main-line fragments at the right and bottom are excluded.
observations.B12: The left brace joins both displayed lines. A heavily canceled G/J-prime-like group remains tentative in the first line. The second component after M has an angular top, lower short horizontal and a clear exclamation with separate dot; E/Gamma is unresolved. The curved lower insertion names M with hat and D-zero; its following equality/definition marks are cramped. The following prose is read in B13.
observations.B13: The top prose overlaps B12; its clipped upper strokes are visible there. The underline begins after G_I and continues through sur. Two separate hats stand over the M symbols. The elevated pt. P0 has a leader descending toward the next line.
observations.B14: The insertion pt. P0 is attached by a long descending leader after dune part. The two trajectory words have long j descenders. Prior-line fragments at the top are excluded.
observations.B15: The affine-symbol letter visibly has a doubled upright and three horizontal bars and is read E. The complement contains the word section and numeral 2. The final subscript is parenthesized T-minus-2. Clipped neighboring traces are excluded.
observations.B16: The two arrows have heads without initial mapsto bars. The lower expression is T plus a fraction with numerator 1 and denominator T. Hats and strokes from the next line at the lower edge are excluded.
observations.B17: The word in quotation marks has an early deep descending loop and a later tall t, suggesting signature but retained as uncertain. The final numeral after T-equals is 2. Upper fragments of the preceding mapping are excluded.
observations.B18: Pencil foliation reads 70; the first numeral has a cross-stroke and the second a closed oval.
